---- MODULE EPIC ----
EXTENDS ModelData
VARIABLES pc, turn
vars == <<pc, turn>>
Init == /\ pc = Initial /\ turn = 0
Move(a) == \E e \in Edges :
    /\ e[1] = pc /\ e[2] = a /\ pc' = e[3] /\ turn' = 1 - turn
Next == \E a \in 1..Len(ActionNames) : Move(a)
Spec == /\ Init /\ [][Next]_vars
        /\ \A a \in WFIds : WF_vars(Move(a))
        /\ \A a \in SFIds : SF_vars(Move(a))
Safety == pc \in SafeNodes
Termination == <>(pc \in DoneNodes)
